notes:
Overview:
- SaaS vendor that runs omnichannel customer support for SMB and mid-market customers. Heavy Zendesk + Confluence usage today. Interested in reducing AHT and improving first-contact resolution via agent-assist and smart suggestions.
- Primary pain: agents pulling context from multiple sources (tickets, KB, product docs, S3 logs) — slow, inconsistent. Need RAG pipeline with clear citations and freshness guarantees.
Technical requirements / preferences:
- Workloads: live agent-assist (low-latency suggestions), async ticket summarization (batch), automatic tool-calling (create/update ticket, tag, escalate).
- Retrieval: must stitch results from Zendesk, Confluence, Salesforce cases, and S3-hosted attachments. Need multi-source reranking; provenance (URL + snippet + timestamp) required for agent UI.
- Freshness: TTL + incremental refresh for hot KB pages. They want sections marked "last-validated"; ability to force reindex after doc updates.
- Latency & throughput targets: typical steady-state 30 concurrent agent sessions; peak spikes 3x–5x during promos. E2E agent-assist SLO: 95th percentile <350ms (retrieval+model suggestion). Ticket summarize batch target: <2s per ticket at 10k/day.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate — prefer batching/caching recommendations to reduce token spend for repeated contexts. Interested in Redwood Optimize suggestions.
- Model preferences: open models with quantization support for Dedicated; want to compare hosted latest Llama-family variants vs. private tuned model for PII redaction.
- Routing/fallback: need policy that routes to cheaper model for low-priority summarization jobs and bumps to larger model for escalation. Automatic fallback to next compatible variant on capacity shortage.
- Safety & audit: strict audit logs for all model outputs and tool calls; integration with their KMS for key management. Retention controls for transcripts per legal policy.
- Tool calling: permissioned actions only (CSM/lead can approve actions). Want SDK hooks for sandbox testing before enabling live ticket updates.
POC scope & milestones:
- 4-week POC. Week 1: connect Zendesk + Confluence + sample S3 corpus; baseline retrieval latency. Week 2: implement RAG pipeline, cite snippets, and present agent UI mock. Week 3: run synthetic spike tests (3x, 5x) and measure latency/failure modes; evaluate autoscaling and burst capacity. Week 4: finalize cost runbook, rollout plan (canary + auto-fallback).
- Success metrics: agent RT suggestion accuracy > 82% (human eval), FCR improvement of 8–12% in POC, <2% invocation failures under 3x spike.
Recent activity (timeline):
- 2025-01-22: Intro call (owner: Tara). noted: "we need citations inline — agents will ask for source link." ff-2025-01-22-8372 transcript.
- 2025-02-10: Deep dive with SE (Marco) on Zendesk connectors and API quotas; shared example export.
- 2025-02-14: Demo of hosted API retrieval + explainability; recorded ff-2025-02-14-4410.
- 2025-02-20: Security questionnaire submitted (drive:/security/sable-security-questions.pdf). Legal asked about retention and deletion workflows.
- 2025-03-04: Internal runbook call; agreed to test both Hosted + Dedicated options for POC.
Risks / open questions:
- Zendesk rate limits may require proxying + caching layer; how does Redwood handle connector-level throttling?
- Need clear SLAs for vector DB persistence and backup for Private deployments.
- PII redaction + on-the-fly masking: do we do pre-retrieval redaction or post-generation filters? Customer leans to pre-retrieval.
Next steps (short):
- Send updated POC scope + commercial (Tara) by 2025-03-07.
- Schedule infra workshop for VPC + KMS on 2025-03-11 (tentative).
- Legal to review SOC2 artifacts; SE to provision sample indexing job and spike tests.
